Andy and Erin shared a moment of hugging, with Andy saying, 'You really think we can get that back?'
Andy admitted to being gay and said, 'I am gay, and I prefer men,' during a scene with Erin.
Andy told Erin, 'I'm in love with a girl. Her name is Erin Hannon and she's right there,' at a party scene.
